name: Simple Dissolve
description: Replaces tiles in a random order, creating a gradual dissolve from the current message to the target.
author: FiestaBoard

tiles_per_frame.title: Tiles per frame
tiles_per_frame.description: How many tiles flip in each step. Larger = faster, less granular.

frame_interval_ms.title: Delay between frames (ms)
frame_interval_ms.description: Time to pause between each step.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Set to a fixed integer for deterministic playback (useful for previews). Leave blank for a fresh random order each run.
